notes.title: Big System Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34778337/2d0675ee30ab59979b5773b4c24c92a1bf74e973.jpg

Big System Update

We have repaired most / all of our wallpaper systems.

Wallpaper design turned out to be something more difficult than we thought. Animated wallpapers for Windows 10 require some system settings. Despite many of our messages, someone still missed them and problems began.

After many tries, it's Big System update is ready. Most problems have probably been fixed.

90% of negative reviews describe what has been fixed:

-I can't control the wallpaper
-I can't turn off the wallpaper
-I can't uninstall this wallpaper
-My menu disappear
-Where is Taskbar to enable the second menu?
-The wallpaper is in window
-False antivirus alert
-Problem with Inputapp.exe process
-3DM website runs on my screen
-Wallpaper won't pause when I start the game
-and more

These problems should be fixed now!

In addition, the new system recognizes if the Windows 10 settings are not correct. After detecting, the wallpaper will automatically change them or show you a video on how to set it. The wallpaper itself will open a window to change the settings to "adjust the best appearance", then click the green "DONE".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34778337/cae73aecef41355cba292522b764ea27aa909939.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34778337/efea90b7df85eb47b84467571d2a7c1534e0d207.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34778337/4e04b630803696c7be36dd95185eada11035cfdc.jpg

There are more patches but the competition is not sleeping so we will keep them to ourselves.

The user with the correct settings will not see the difference at the beginning but in the end, the project will work much better with it.

We are very pleased that finally, we have created the system with which we are satisfied.

Everything has been tested on many PCs and everything works as it should. If you have any problems, please write below. We will fix immediately.

Some programs may still block our projects, but this is very, very rare.

Please update our project and enjoy!

I would also like to apologize to those who had problems with the settings. Creating wallpaper requires certain technologies but now everything should play.

Thank you also for the support of our users. Your suggestions have helped us a lot and today you can see the effects. Thanks.

Best Regards,

3DM

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34778337/5d7390bcab2d879f123fd6ad8d938c2e2e57007f.jpg

notes.title: Access Update + Task Menu
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34778337/f170e79cc846697f6a23a8b05432bf543b558999.jpg

A new window checking the settings of Windows 10 and the menu added to the Task Menu.

Our wallpapers require standard Windows 10 settings. Unfortunately, about 10% of our users have different settings, which blocks the mouse and access to the menu. Almost all negative reviews are from these people.

We decided to add a window informing about the necessary settings of Windows 10. It is required to accept this window for the wallpaper to work. We also noticed that some of the goat's use our wallpapers with blocked interaction. This additional window should help anyone with this problem.

The window contains information about the required settings and a "Community HUB" photo in which you will learn how to set Windows 10 to standard settings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34778337/4e04b630803696c7be36dd95185eada11035cfdc.jpg

We have also added a menu on the Windows 10 toolbar (Task Menu) from which you can manage the wallpaper. It will be very useful for users with multiple screens when the menu goes out of screens. You can now change the menu items from the Task Menu.


Small bugs reported by our users have also been corrected. Thank you for that.

Unfortunately, the introduced changes will restart all wallpaper settings. Excuse me.

We have tested the patch on several PCs but if you still have problems accessing the menu, please let us know.

Best Regards
3DM

notes.title: Fresh Release
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34778337/951b6d1c02d8cf469810367f94458194cbacf4a4.jpg

The new exciting project is ready.

We decided to build an editor that allows creating effective particles that react to the mouse. So we prepared ready scenes and their parts that can be modified. The project was created thanks to the asset that simulates the UltimateVFX particle movement. The work on this project was very nice, however, there was a delay by work on improving the wallpaper system so that more would not show fake antivirus reports ... And we repaired it by moving the Energy Engine's premiere for another month.

However, everything went well and the wallpaper is already in the store collecting great reviews. Thanks!

The project will be improved and enriched with additional presets ready for change.

We are happy to hear your suggestions if you have a nice idea or what to fix.

This project finishes a certain stage for 3DM.
From this moment, we will be working on a completely new and unique series of interactive wallpapers based on AI.

You can find more information on our social media or website.

Thank you all for support. This project was possible thanks to you.

3DM
